summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned only by maintain-knowledge-base with separate append-only maintainer-confirmed request; request binds caller, trigger, one target plan, pinned current main commit, non-automatic status, timestamp, knowledge-publication authority, and hash-verified stale Acceptance route; publish_knowledge_catalog.py --publish fails closed without bindings; stale Acceptance route is typed, hash-bound, non-authorizing, append-only in target plan; VDD/Acceptance restrict outputs to exact declared target directory; catalog indexes stable semantic plan sources only, excluding authority manifests and knowledge contexts; standalone builder read-only, publication gate alone activates layers/pointers with validated capability; discovery supports versioned top-level files, highest numeric version, requirements-ledger and requirements names; historical generations remain compatible, new authorized publications record summary/hash; extends ADR-0044/0048/0050, supersedes none; breaks recursive freshness loop and prevents sibling-plan mutation
